parameters.query: SELECT topic_title FROM videos ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50;

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $env.OPENAI_TEXT_MODEL || 'gpt-5.4-mini', messages: [{ role: 'system', content: `You are a senior YouTube content strategist. Channel niche: ${$json.channel_niche}. Return valid JSON only.` }, { role: 'user', content: `${$json.channel_analysis && !$json.channel_analysis.error ? 'REFERENCE CHANNEL (REAL data from YouTube Data API):
' + JSON.stringify($json.channel_analysis, null, 2) + '

Study the title patterns, hooks, and topics of the top videos above. Identify what drives retention on this channel. Then create ONE NEW topic that fits the same audience and pattern but is original.

' : ($json.channel_url ? 'Note: channel URL provided but could not be fetched (' + ($json.channel_analysis?.error || 'no API key') + '). Operate from niche only.

' : '')}Create ONE high-retention video topic package for a ${$json.channel_niche} YouTube channel.
Do NOT reuse these topics: [${$json.previous_topics}].
Output JSON: title, core_emotion, audience_promise, thumbnail_text, seo_keywords (array), hook_angle, story_seed, why_this_works.` }] } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $env.OPENAI_TEXT_MODEL || 'gpt-5.4-mini', messages: [{ role: 'system', content: 'You are a YouTube retention editor. Return valid JSON only.' }, { role: 'user', content: `QA check this script. Score 0-100 for: retention, emotional clarity, topic accuracy, YouTube suitability.
Return JSON: score_0_100, verdict (pass/fail), issues (array), suggested_fixes (array).

Script:
${$json.script.narration_script}` }] } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $env.OPENAI_IMAGE_MODEL || 'gpt-image-2', prompt: `YouTube thumbnail for: ${$json.title}. Text overlay area: ${$json.thumbnail_text}. Style: ${$json.seo_keywords?.join(', ')}. Cinematic, emotional, high contrast, no watermark, no logo.`, size: '1536x1024' }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'accepted', episode_id: $('Code - Merge Config').first().json.episode_id, scenes: $('Code - Build Manifest').first().json.scenes?.length, worker_response: $input.first().json }) }}

meta.description: Generic full-auto YouTube pipeline: channel analysis → topic → GPT script → Claude refinement → QA → scene breakdown → DALL-E images → Python worker. Works for any niche.
